### Fixed
 
 - Fixed charts in answers drawing as blank bands, on screen and in scrollback, when iTerm2 drew them in a background tab; inline images now carry an explicit height in rows ([#16471](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16471) by [@galtamam-cmyk](https://github.com/galtamam-cmyk))
+### Fixed
+
+- Fixed the collapsed streaming `write` preview changing height line-by-line as tokens arrive, which shifted every row on screen; the partial trailing line is now budgeted into a viewport-sized tail window that re-slices on resize, and only a filesystem write that outgrows that window asks for a scrollback-wiping repaint when its first result arrives — a write that still fits it, or an `agent://`/`proc://`/`cfg://` card that keeps its own head preview, no longer wipes the scrollback, so the row count holds steady until the preview is expanded ([#16033](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16033), [#16099](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16099) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))

- Fixed hashline block edits (`PUT N*:`, `CUT N*`) applying over block lines a `read` never fully showed, such as a line cut at the column cap, which silently dropped that line's tail; they are now rejected like the equivalent explicit range ([#16209](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16209))
 - Fixed a resumed session's next snapcompact compaction losing the newest archived history once the archive passed 500k characters, and drawing `[Session persistence truncated large content]` into its frames; the archive's source text is now saved whole ([#16282](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16282) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
 - Fixed `/compact`, `/new` or a session switch during a running tool dropping that tool's result from the session file, so the model and a resumed session saw "No result provided" instead of what the tool returned ([#16241](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16241) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
+- Fixed `createLegacyPiVirtualModulePlugin()` failing with ENOENT outside the monorepo: the bundled Pi packages are now resolved through the installed dependency graph, so a host compiling its own binary can bundle legacy Pi modules from an npm install ([#15208](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15208))

commented_code:
- Fixed Cursor models served through `omp auth-gateway` being told their file and shell tools were unavailable while the client ran the calls anyway, in Cursor's own argument shape (edits failed validation); each call now reaches the client as one of its own tools and the turn stops with `toolUse` until the result comes back ([#17382](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17382) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))
 - Fixed Cursor models served through `omp auth-gateway` being told each tool call was handed off, which left Composer issuing calls blind and answering their results with empty stops; the gateway now keeps the Cursor run open while the client runs a step's calls and answers them in-band with the client's results on its next request (up to 30 minutes; otherwise the turn is rebuilt from history as before) ([#17382](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17382) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))
 - Fixed Anthropic-compatible endpoints behind a relay opening a new connection for every turn: the response body is now drained for up to 2.5 s after `message_stop` instead of being cancelled, so the kept-alive connection is reused ([#17432](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17432) by [@flosrn](https://github.com/flosrn))
+- Fixed Responses API requests rejecting documented null values for temperature, output limits, reasoning, and reasoning summaries ([#17466](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17466) by [@Xytronix](https://github.com/Xytronix)).
